content:
Just now, the AirPods Pro 3 dropped to one of the lowest prices ever, as the autumn Prime Day sale quickly brought the latest Mac product deals flooding in. The brand-new M6 Mac mini series hit its all-time lowest prices, with savings of nearly US$150, while the 2026 Mac Studio also saw discounts of close to US$200.

These deals also cover almost every M5 MacBook Air model with a US$200 discount, the ongoing US$500 off promotion for the M5 Pro MacBook Pro, the launch discount for Apple's newly released minimalist full-character design Magic Keyboard, and the rare price cut on the Magic Mouse.

For those looking to buy a MacBook, the autumn Prime Day is bringing the lowest prices in months for Apple's M5 MacBook Air lineup. Amazon is now offering a solid US$200 discount on nearly every configuration, with most models available in multiple colours:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB US$1,099 (original price US$1,299)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB US$1,399 (original price US$1,599)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB US$1,599 (original price US$1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB US$1,299 (original price US$1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB US$1,599 (original price US$1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB US$1,799 (original price US$1,999)

Amazon this morning brought some extremely eye-catching price cuts on Apple's brand-new Mac mini lineup. From the entry-level M6 configuration to the more powerful M5 Max model, we are tracking discounts of up to US$149, setting the all-time lowest prices:

  • 2026 M6 Mac mini 16GB/256GB US$780 (original price US$899) — all-time low
  • 2026 M6 Mac mini 16GB/512GB US$950 (original price US$1,099) — all-time low
  • 2026 M5 Max Mac mini 24GB/512GB US$1,550 (original price US$1,699) — all-time low

These deals come alongside the all-time lowest price for the brand-new Mac Studio equipped with 36GB RAM, with Amazon now cutting the price by US$199 — the best offer we have seen since it went on sale last month:

  • 2026 M5 Max Mac Studio US$2,300 (original price US$2,499) — all-time low

Although we are still waiting for (and hoping for) more MacBook Pro discounts, Amazon is still offering a sizeable US$500 discount on this upgraded 2TB model — a deal that effectively makes this configuration US$100 cheaper than its official price before the increase:

  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB US$2,699 (original price US$3,199)

In addition, we are also tracking some excellent discounts on Apple Mac accessories. Specifically, both the black and white Magic Mouse are enjoying a rare discount of close to 25% off the listed price, while Apple's latest newly released Magic Keyboard, featuring a minimalist full-character key design, is also迎来 its first discount offer:

  • Apple Magic Keyboard (brand-new 2026 model) US$80 (original price US$99)
  • Apple Magic Mouse white US$60 (original price US$79)
  • Apple Magic Mouse black US$80 (original price US$99)
